statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The diagnostic study is directly indicated by the clinical presentation
The study supports appropriate management of the patient's cardiac condition
